description: Lockheed L-049 Constellation c/n 2081, delivered 1946 as N90819 to TWA, then YV-C-AME 'Francisco de Miranda' (LAV), N2520B (Braniff 1955-60); on 30 July 1961 it was forced down at El Trompillo by FAB P-51s while smuggling (one Mustang pilot died), confiscated, and moved to this city plaza in 1979, where it has served as a library, a Banco de Crédito branch and advertising for Pepsi and AeroSur. Repainted green/white in January 2023; Aerospotter (July 2026) confirms it still stands.
